description: This Java class implements the Data Access Object (DAO) for TaxClass entities, providing methods to query taxa by store, code, or ID within the sales manager application.

classes.name: TaxClassDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access object for TaxClass, providing CRUD and query operations based on store, code, and ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of TaxClass objects associated with a given MerchantStore, including those with null merchant store associations.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a TaxClass by its unique identifier.
